prs.title: Gracefully terminate active sessions during StreamableHTTP shutdown
prs.author: Bortlesboat
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed during server shutdown, causing EventSourceResponse coroutines to be cancelled mid-stream and Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs fix this by iterating `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and calling `writer.close()`, then also adding a pre-cancellation termination loop in the `lifespan` shutdown path of `streamable_http_manager.py`. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed during server shutdown, causing EventSourceResponse coroutines to be cancelled mid-stream and Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs fix this by iterating `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and calling `writer.close()`, then also adding a pre-cancellation termination loop in the `lifespan` shutdown path of `streamable_http_manager.py`. prs.cluster_pick_reason: #2259 is a strict superset of #2253: it adds the same SSE writer teardown and lifespan shutdown loop, but also adds an idempotency guard (`if self._terminated: return`) to prevent double-termination races, and omits the `# pragma: no cover` annotation on the new loop so the branch is covered by tests. #2253 lacks the idempotency guard and marks the new code as uncovered.

members.title: fix: terminate active StreamableHTTP sessions during shutdown
members.author: weiguangli-io
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2259: Active SSE stream writers are not closed during server shutdown, causing EventSourceResponse coroutines to be cancelled mid-stream and Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs fix this by iterating `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and calling `writer.close()`, then also adding a pre-cancellation termination loop in the `lifespan` shutdown path of `streamable_http_manager.py`.
